mode.description: Operation mode: 'trace' for recording, 'import' for analyzing existing traces.

trace_file.description: Path to the trace file used for input (import) or output (trace).

duration.description: Duration in seconds to capture data in trace mode.

command.description: Command to execute during tracing. If empty, idlestat runs standalone.

baseline_trace.description: Path to baseline trace file for comparison reports.

report_format.description: Report format: default, boxless, csv, or comparison.

output_file.description: File path to write the final report. Empty string means stdout.

verbose.description: Verbosity level (0-2). Higher values increase output detail.

energy_model.description: Path to the energy model file for power calculations.

buffer_size.description: Kernel FTRACE buffer size in KB. 0 uses default.

poll_interval.description: Kernel polling interval in microseconds. 0 uses default.
